crossRefs.note: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach…
Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”
You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the…
Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”
But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I…
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

parallels.note: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
translations.bsb: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
translations.asv: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee; and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
